answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by a non-collusive voting tree that binds each identity to a distinct stake deposit, so a sparrow cannot masquerade as many birds without locking fresh capital per node. Validators propagate attestations along a vine of chained endorsements, and honest peers award nectar only to branches whose unique-deposit proofs survive cross-checking. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
